description: This file implements hook-related functionalities for a Git repository, including finding, executing, and managing hooks and their options.

classes.name: struct hook_cb_data
classes.description: Contains callback data for hook execution, including hook path, return code, and options.

classes.name: struct run_hooks_opt
classes.description: Holds options for running hooks, including environment variables, arguments, error handling, and callback pointers.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository; used as a context in hook related functions.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Represents a process to be run, with configuration for inputs, outputs, environment, and execution parameters.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Searches for an executable hook file in the repository's hooks directory, optionally trying to strip extensions.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks whether a specified hook exists and is executable.

methods.name: int pick_next_hook(struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Prepares a child process to execute the next hook, configuring environment and input as needed.

methods.name: int notify_start_failure(struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles notification when hook execution fails to start.

methods.name: int notify_hook_finished(int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles notification and cleanup after a hook execution finishes.

methods.name: void run_hooks_opt_clear(struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Clears dynamically allocated environment variables and arguments in hook options.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Executes hooks with specified options, managing process creation and error handling.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
methods.description: Runs hooks with default options for a given repository and hook name.

methods.name: int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)
methods.description: Runs hooks with a variable list of arguments, simplifying invocation with additional command-line args.
